name: Passbolt Community Edition Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0 Community Edition password and secret manager for teams, self-hosted with credential sharing and browser clients; no software subscription fee.
watch_out: Requires your own PHP/database server, TLS, email setup, backups and security updates. Cloud-hosted Passbolt is a separate paid service with only a short trial; paid enterprise capabilities are excluded. AGPL-3.0 source and trademark conditions apply.
